description: Header file defining the HpackVarintDecoder class for decoding HPACK variable length unsigned integers, used in HTTP/2 and QPACK implementations. Contains class declaration, constants, and method signatures.

classes.name: HpackVarintDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding HPACK variable length unsigned integers in a resumable fashion.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes decoding with the first byte and prefix length, using the decode buffer.

methods.name: StartExtended
methods.description: Initializes decoding for multi-byte varints when the prefix bits are all 1.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding after an incomplete previous decode.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the decoded value, mainly for testing.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string for debugging purposes.

methods.name: StartForTest
methods.description: Test version of Start, for benchmarking.

methods.name: StartExtendedForTest
methods.description: Test version of StartExtended, for benchmarking.

methods.name: ResumeForTest
methods.description: Test version of Resume, for benchmarking.
